ROOT_CAUSE_FOUND_WRITES_WERE_NEVER_BLOCK.ROOT_CAUSE: Telegraph changed its createPage/editPage API. It no longer accepts an HTML string; it requires a JSON node list whose children are plain strings.
ROOT_CAUSE_FOUND_WRITES_WERE_NEVER_BLOCK.conclusion_that_matters: the channel was never closed. Nothing about the account was wrong. This is the most consequential error of the last several cycles - a working free distribution channel was reported as blocked on two separate cycles, and the founder was told not to retry.
ROOT_CAUSE_FOUND_WRITES_WERE_NEVER_BLOCK.permanent_guard: docs/telegraph_api_format.md documents the accepted shape, the full error map observed live, and the verification rule that a createPage ok response is not proof of rendering.

TWO_PROBLEMS_THAT_WERE_CONFLATED.lesson: a general 'Telegraph writes are blocked' claim is false and must not be repeated. Only the pre-existing pages are affected.

LINK_IS_PLAIN_TEXT_NOT_AN_ANCHOR.finding: Telegraph strips anchor nodes. An {'type':'a',...} child is dropped on create AND on edit, including for internal telegra.ph hrefs. A paragraph containing only a link node returns CONTENT_TEXT_REQUIRED.
LINK_IS_PLAIN_TEXT_NOT_AN_ANCHOR.workaround: the full URL is published as its own paragraph of plain text, which renders and is copy-pasteable
LINK_IS_PLAIN_TEXT_NOT_AN_ANCHOR.tradeoff_accepted: a visible URL is copied far less often than a clickable one. This is a real reduction in conversion versus a clickable anchor, disclosed rather than hidden.
LINK_IS_PLAIN_TEXT_NOT_AN_ANCHOR.not_false_claimed: no clickable product link is claimed for this article
